text: Carter Care Clinic routes 100 percent of its payouts through a single account, which is the only strong feature this alert carries — its 52 claims arrive from a broad mix of brokers (top feeder only 19.2 percent), it has been registered for 14.6 years, and most of its patients have wider graph history. Payout concentration alone is the documented honest pattern of a small clinic with one corporate account, which is precisely why this scores low. The single-doctor roster on 52 claims is the only other wrinkle, and it is mild. No feeder dependency, no address sharing, no transient patient base. Next step: none standalone — the alert exists so payout concentration stays visible, not because this clinic resembles a shell.
